description: This file defines interfaces and utility functions for synchronizing local data with a remote source in an Android application. It includes synchronization marker interfaces, error handling, and a generic change list synchronization process.

classes.name: Synchronizer
classes.description: Interface marker for managing synchronization between local data and a remote source.

classes.name: Syncable
classes.description: Interface marker for objects that can be synchronized with a remote source.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Extension method for Syncable to call syncWith without explicitly passing the synchronizer.

methods.name: suspendRunCatching
methods.description: Executes a suspend lambda, returning Result.success if successful, otherwise logs and returns Result.failure.

methods.name: changeListSync
methods.description: Core utility function for syncing change lists, handling fetch, delete, update, and version updates transactionally.
